hypotheses: The official IT chat template, one BOS, all three stop IDs and modality suppression remove the known PT-path formatting failures; test actual responses, not only toy-model execution.
Comparison sampling (top-k 0, top-p 1) may differ from native sampling (top-k 64, top-p .95); paired fixed-candidate controls are diagnostic, not a capability ranking.
Short token budgets can lower measured reward by truncating valid reasoning. Keep 512-token diagnostics separate from the actual 2048-token protocol.

data_and_transformation.transformation: Official IT chat template; no question, answer or split changes; original cached rewards cleared for new IT cohorts.
data_and_transformation.controls: Synthetic arithmetic/code canaries are separate from actual candidate slices. Offset 1 MATH is the historical PT failure case (age problem); offset 1 MBPP is a corresponding fixed regression case. This is deliberately a regression panel, not a representative sample.

design.budget_note: 512 for bounded offset-0 diagnostics, 2048 for offset-1 regression, 64 for synthetic canaries. The actual experiment budget remains 2048.
design.pairing: Same candidate IDs and candidate_seed(5,id) for comparison/native controls; no conclusions from one stochastic draw per prompt.

metric_definitions.reward: Binary reward from the production MATH or parent-checked MBPP verifier.
metric_definitions.success_percent: 100 * sum(recorded binary rewards) / recorded response count within the named diagnostic group only.
metric_definitions.empty: Decoded response is blank after stripping whitespace.
metric_definitions.truncated: Last generated token is not any official stop ID [1,106,50].
metric_definitions.suppressed_tokens: Count of generated official suppressed modality IDs [258883,258882].

checkpoints.reason: No training; reproduction uses the pinned and verified original IT checkpoint. No learned checkpoint exists.

code_provenance: source-verification.json maps every run to its exact implementation commit using both recorded source digests. Raw reports retain their original source_commit field.

bounded_control_status: Stopped after both matched MATH draws hit the artificial 512-token diagnostic cap. Both completed MATH responses scored zero and were truncated; MBPP draws had no completed receipts and remain unmeasured. This is not full-cache performance.
completion_scope: Actual-weight fixed regression and synthetic controls complete; 512-token paired controls stopped with censoring recorded. Full initial caches, held-out evaluation and training have not been run.
measured_findings: Synthetic arithmetic/code canaries both passed with greedy generation and a 64-token cap. This is a basic instruction/verifier check only.

The fixed offset-1 MATH age regression produced Answer: 6, reward 1, 386 tokens, stopped normally within the actual 2048-token budget. The paired MBPP range-sum regression passed its original tests, reward 1, 682 tokens, stopped normally. Each is one prompt and one sampled response; neither is a population accuracy estimate.

Matched offset-0 MATH controls at an artificial 512-token cap both truncated and scored zero. They are a different question from the offset-1 full-budget regression, so the two slices cannot identify a causal token-budget or sampler effect. MBPP had no completed receipt in either stopped control and remains unmeasured.
None of the six completed saved diagnostic responses was blank or contained suppressed modality IDs. This does not establish that such failures are impossible on the full cohort.
